test_title: PYST 18: SSC MTS - General Awareness (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following short form stands for Union Government Program for Urban Development?
solution:
The correct answer is __**AMRUT**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Jawaharlal Nehru National Urban Renewal Mission **was renamed the **Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT) **and relaunched in June 2015 by Prime Minister of India Narendra Modi, with the goal of establishing infrastructure that could ensure adequate, robust sewage networks and water supply for urban transformation through the implementation of urban revival projects.
 
• **Rajasthan** was the first state in the country to submit a State Annual Action Plan for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation under the Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT).
 
• On the same day, the Housing for All by 2022 initiative and the Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT) were announced. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• On May 1, 2016, Prime Minister of India Narendra Modi announced the commencement of the **Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana**, which aims to provide 50 million LPG connections to women from Below Poverty Line families.
 
• **Ujjwal Assurance from DISCOM Yojana** is a financial turnaround and revival package for India's energy distribution firms, launched by the Indian government with the goal of finding a long-term solution to the country's financial crisis.
 
• PM Narendra Modi, on behalf of the Indian government, announced the** UJALA **initiative on May 1, 2015.
